'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Andrew Clark LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Clark]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Username:''' cloudburst
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
